quarterly_data.quarter: Digital Realty press release: Digital Realty Commences Construction of KIX15 Data Center, (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Digital Realty commenced construction of KIX15, a new 24 megawatt (MW) data center at its KIX Campus in Ibaraki City, Osaka Prefecture, Japan, developed by MC Digital Realty (MCDR), its 50/50 joint venture in Japan with Mitsubishi Corporation. KIX15 will be the fifth data center at the KIX Campus and is scheduled to commence operations in the fourth quarter of 2028; upon completion it brings MCDR's Japan portfolio to 10 data centers, representing approximately 220 MW of aggregate IT capacity. The facility is designed to support hybrid air- and liquid-cooling technologies and is expected to support customers including hyperscalers, cloud service providers and companies deploying AI infrastructure; it is a key component of MCDR's Kansai AI Infrastructure Co-Creation Project. The expansion follows the opening earlier this year of the NRT14 data center in Inzai City, Chiba Prefecture, which the company calls one of the first facilities in Japan to achieve the DGX-Ready Data Center certification. Serene Nah, Managing Director and Head of Asia Pacific: 'Japan is a strategic market for Digital Realty and a key part of our long-term growth in Asia Pacific.'
